xml_snippets.Title: Peaceful (DifficultyDef)
xml_snippets.Label: peaceful
xml_snippets.Description Originale: Build a community in a sandbox environment. Major direct threats are disabled, but challenges like disease, mental breaks, and mad animals can still occur.
xml_snippets.XML:
<DifficultyDef>

    <defName>Peaceful</defName>

    <label>peaceful</label>

    <description>Build a community in a sandbox environment. Major direct threats are disabled, but challenges like disease, mental breaks, and mad animals can still occur.



(*SectionTitle)Recommended for:(/SectionTitle)



- Players who want to learn the game mechanics with minimal pressure.

- Players who just want to build.

- Players who just want to relax.</description>

    <difficulty>0</difficulty>

    <threatScale>0.10</threatScale>

    <allowBigThreats>false</allowBigThreats>

    <allowIntroThreats>false</allowIntroThreats>

    <peacefulTemples>true</peacefulTemples>

    <allowCaveHives>false</allowCaveHives>

    <allowViolentQuests>false</allowViolentQuests>

    <predatorsHuntHumanlikes>false</predatorsHuntHumanlikes>

    <colonistMoodOffset>10</colonistMoodOffset>

    <cropYieldFactor>1.20</cropYieldFactor>

    <mineYieldFactor>1.20</mineYieldFactor>

    <researchSpeedFactor>1.20</researchSpeedFactor>

    <diseaseIntervalFactor>3</diseaseIntervalFactor>

    <enemyReproductionRateFactor>0.1</enemyReproductionRateFactor>

    <playerPawnInfectionChanceFactor>0.3</playerPawnInfectionChanceFactor>

    <manhunterChanceOnDamageFactor>0.25</manhunterChanceOnDamageFactor>

    <deepDrillInfestationChanceFactor>0</deepDrillInfestationChanceFactor>

    <wastepackInfestationChanceFactor>0</wastepackInfestationChanceFactor>

    <nomadicMineableResourcesFactor>1</nomadicMineableResourcesFactor>

    <foodPoisonChanceFactor>0.3</foodPoisonChanceFactor>

    <maintenanceCostFactor>1</maintenanceCostFactor>

    <enemyDeathOnDownedChanceFactor>0.5</enemyDeathOnDownedChanceFactor>

    <adaptationGrowthRateFactorOverZero>0</adaptationGrowthRateFactorOverZero>

    <scariaRotChance>0</scariaRotChance>

    <allowExtremeWeatherIncidents>false</allowExtremeWeatherIncidents>

    <minThreatPointsRangeCeiling>45</minThreatPointsRangeCeiling>

    <studyEfficiencyFactor>2</studyEfficiencyFactor>

  </DifficultyDef>

xml_snippets.Description Originale: This setting is designed to be unfair. Huge threats will crash upon you without mercy until your colony dies. Only choose this setting if you are happy with the drama of struggling and dying.
